'''Snowmass''' was an [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] in [[Molpol's Traveling Circus]]. After the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]] forced a landing by a small fleet of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] maintained by the [[Circus/Legends|circus]] to land on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Regosh]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] stole the circus' [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|lander]]. The [[Beastmaster/Legends|animal handlers]] began loading their small animals on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]] to save them from Regosh's predators, but Snowmass believed the ship was eating them an attempted to attack the ship. None of the remaining craft had the capacity to evacuate the larger circus animals, including Snowmass, so they were left to adapt to the moon's native habitat. Snowmass was said to be enjoying freedom in the wild.
